rule_en: Past perfect (had + past participle) = the earlier of two past actions. Past simple = the later action. Use past perfect to show what had already happened before another past moment.
rule_bn: দুটি অতীত কাজের মধ্যে আগেরটি → past perfect (had + V3); পরেরটি → past simple।

sessions.title: Spot the Error
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the wrong word, then choose the fix.

items.prompt_en: By the time I joined the team, they shipped the Salesforce app
items.explain_en: The shipping happened before I joined, so the earlier past action takes past perfect 'had shipped'.

items.prompt_en: After we had fixed the bug, the customer had reopened the ticket
items.explain_en: Only the earlier action ('had fixed') uses past perfect; the later action takes past simple 'reopened'.

items.prompt_en: By the time the demo started, she deployed the hotfix
items.explain_en: The deploy happened before the demo started, so the earlier action takes past perfect 'had deployed'.

items.prompt_en: When the manager called, I already finished the demo
items.explain_en: Finishing the demo came before the call, so it takes past perfect 'had already finished'.

items.prompt_en: Before I learned Apex, I had never wrote a single line of code
items.explain_en: Past perfect needs the past participle, so 'had never wrote' becomes 'had never written'.

items.prompt_en: The build failed because someone has changed the config earlier
items.explain_en: The change happened before the failure in the past, so use past perfect 'had changed', not present perfect.

items.prompt_en: Once she had merged the branch, the pipeline starting running
items.explain_en: The later action after the merge takes past simple 'started', not past perfect or a bare gerund.

items.prompt_en: I realized that I forgotten to save the new report before the demo
items.explain_en: Forgetting happened before I realized it, so the earlier action needs past perfect 'had forgotten'.

items.prompt_en: After the server had crashed, the team had restarted it quickly
items.explain_en: Only the earlier action ('had crashed') uses past perfect; the later restart takes past simple 'restarted'.

items.prompt_en: By the time the meeting ended, we had agree on the new plan
items.explain_en: Past perfect needs the past participle, so 'had agree' becomes 'had agreed'.

sessions.title: Choose & Fill
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the correct option or chip.

items.prompt_en: By the time the demo started, the team ___ all the bugs.
items.explain_en: Past perfect (had fixed) marks the earlier action completed before the later past action (the demo started).

items.prompt_en: When I opened the org, I realized someone ___ my validation rule.
items.explain_en: The change happened before I opened the org, so the earlier action takes past perfect (had changed).

items.prompt_en: She deployed the fix only after she ___ it in the sandbox.
items.explain_en: Testing came first, then deploying; the earlier action uses past perfect after 'after'.

items.prompt_en: The build failed because the developer ___ to commit the new file.
items.explain_en: The forgetting happened before the build failed, so the earlier cause uses past perfect (had forgotten).

items.prompt_en: By 2022, he ___ three Salesforce certifications.
items.explain_en: 'By 2022' sets a past point, and past perfect shows the earning was completed before it.

items.prompt_en: By the time anyone replied, the ticket ___ open for two weeks.
items.explain_en: The ticket stayed open before anyone replied, so the earlier action uses past perfect (had stayed).

items.prompt_en: By the time the meeting ended, I realized I ___ to share my screen the whole time.
items.explain_en: The forgetting started before I realized it, so past perfect (had forgotten) marks the earlier action.

items.prompt_en: We couldn't merge the branch because she ___ already deleted it.
items.explain_en: 'Already' before another past action signals past perfect; 'had + deleted' shows the earlier action.

items.prompt_en: By the time the manager arrived, the standup ___ finished.
items.explain_en: The standup finished before the manager arrived, so the earlier action uses past perfect 'had finished'.

items.prompt_en: By the time QA started testing, the developers ___ the feature.
items.explain_en: The feature was finished before QA started, so the earlier action takes past perfect: had finished.

sessions.title: Build It
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the tiles in the right order. For speak items, say it out loud.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: By the time the demo started , I had already deployed the new flow .
items.explain_en: Past perfect (had deployed) marks the earlier action; past simple (started) marks the later one.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: She had written the test class before she pushed the code .
items.explain_en: 'Before' shows order: the earlier action takes past perfect (had written), the later takes past simple (pushed).

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: The build failed because someone had changed the API version .
items.explain_en: The change happened first (had changed), so it precedes the failure in past simple (failed).

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: When I joined the team , they had finished the migration .
items.explain_en: The migration was already complete (had finished) before the past-simple moment of joining.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: He realized he had forgotten his laptop after he left home .
items.explain_en: The forgetting (had forgotten) happened before he later realized it.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: After the customer had reported the bug , we fixed it quickly .
items.explain_en: After + past perfect (had reported) shows the report came first, then the past-simple fix.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: I had never used Apex before I started this job .
items.explain_en: Past perfect with 'never...before' shows no prior experience up to the later past moment (started).

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: The release went smoothly because we had tested everything carefully .
items.explain_en: The testing (had tested) was completed before the later past-simple release (went).

items.prompt_en: Say a sentence about something you had already finished before a meeting started yesterday.
items.model_en: By the time the standup started, I had already merged my pull request.

items.prompt_en: Say a sentence using past perfect to explain why a deployment failed last week.
items.model_en: The deployment failed because we hadn't updated the config file.
